_comment: Tags every CSD 2026 ticket with a validation rule (from the triangulation matrix) and a rejection reason (discovered from the tickets). Both modules share this profile so they also share one checkpoint, with a per-module sentinel. Input is written by notebooks/08_csd_2026_validation_rules.ipynb - stubs removed, conversations capped at 16000 chars, ticket id and conversation only - not the raw ticket file.
